snippet.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Vice City, USA.
Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

Check out the new Launch Trailer, featuring new music from electronic duo Justice, composers of the original score from Grand Theft Auto VI.

The new standalone Justice single, “Flower in a Hurricane” feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD at https://gtavi-thealbum.com.

Listen to “Flower in a Hurricane” now: https://justice.lnk.to/flowerinahurricane

This trailer was captured entirely in-game from a PlayStation 5.

Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19.

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. snippet.title: Is It POSSIBLE To BEAT Five Nights at Freddy's 1 With DOUBLED ANIMATRONICS?
snippet.description:
Why does FNAF 1 not have two of each animatronic...because it's a bad idea.

Second Channel (for the proof) - https://www.youtube.com/@UCwvwBWB_x5CWsYJG-OymzeA 

Intro Music: "FNAF 1 Song - Mq_ REMIX" by Mq_ ||  https://youtu.be/LXF1pZlzFDc?si=8AJtkEEpX41ji-Zk
Thumbnail Renders by TheUnbearable101 - Deviant Art

FNAF Challenge Playlist : https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLBDxwxm_4FVPE3ZgSmNxF825y-JY8falc&si=hL0VTAO4NYHw0qca

In this video, I attempt to 100% complete Five Nights at Freddy's 1, but with a twist. I've modded the original FNAF 1 to duplicate all four animatronics, meaning I now have to survive against 2 Freddys, 2 Bonnies, 2 Chicas, and 2 Foxys all at the same time. That's EIGHT animatronics hunting me throughout the pizzeria instead of the usual four.

Every other mechanic in the game remains the same. The cameras, doors, lights, power system, animatronic AI, and night progression all function as they normally would. The only difference is that there are now two copies of every animatronic, each with their own chances to move and path to the office.

The goal is to complete every night, including Night 6 and the infamous 4/20 Mode, while dealing with twice as many animatronics as the game was originally designed for.

The biggest challenge is balancing all eight animatronics while using the same limited resources. Closing the doors too often can drain power, but leaving them open at the wrong time can immediately end the night. So, is it actually possible to beat Five Nights at Freddy's 1 with every animatronic DOUBLED?

Lets see...

The Rules:
- Beat the ENTIRE Game (Nights 1-5, Night 6 and 4/20 Mode)
- Play with the animatronics DOUBLED...obviously
- No Cheese Strats/Glitches

snippet.title: Yele • Wisin - A Donde Iré (Official Video)
snippet.description:
Yele x Wisin - A Donde Iré (Official Video)

Escucha "A Donde Iré " en tu plataforma favorita: 
https://linktr.ee/yelenamusica

Suscríbete al Canal:    /  @Yelenamusica  

Sígueme en todas mis redes 
Instagram:   / https://www.instagram.com/yelenamorera
Facebook:    / https://www.facebook.com/yelenamusica
Tiktok:  / https://www.tiktok.com/@yelenamusica

Letra / Lyric:

Yo no soy nadie, pero tú me sigues dando todo.
Señor gracias por tu misericordia.

¿A dónde iré?
Si en el dolor yo siempre veo tu mano,
Si solo en ti, Padre, yo siempre he confiado,
En el silencio tú no dejas de obrar. 

¿A dónde iré? 
Si desde el día que escuché tus palabras,
Y pude ver en la manera en que obras, 
No existe nada que me aparte de ti. 

Por eso a ti clamaré, 
Pues de mi vida te he entregado el centro,
De no buscarte antes me lamento,
Hoy vas conmigo, pues te llevo dentro de mi corazón. 

A ti clamaré, 
Pues si la noche se hace fría y larga, 
Yo voy a ti y te entrego mis cargas,
Aunque el sol salga por donde salga, 
Sé que has sido Tú. 

Yo creía que ya no podía, 
Que todo era oscuro, no veía la luz. 
Andaba perdido sin rumbo fijo,
Hasta que choqué con la cruz. 

Cambiaste mi vida, lo malo por bueno. 
Y pude cambiar mi actitud. 
Antes creía que era suerte, 
Pero ahora sé que lo hizo Jesús. 

Misericordioso, Todopoderoso, 
Sin merecerlo para Él soy valioso. 
Contigo nada es imposible,
Es que tú siempre serás milagroso. 
Lo que me ofrece el mundo todos los días
Puede que sea engañoso, 
Pero tú tienes algo mejor,
Tú eres maravilloso.
Por eso a ti clamaré, 
Pues de mi vida te he entregado el centro,
De no buscarte antes me lamento,
Hoy vas conmigo, pues te llevo dentro de mi corazón. 

A ti clamaré, 
Pues si la noche se hace fría y larga, 
Yo voy a ti y te entrego mis cargas,
Aunque el sol salga por donde salga,
Sé que has sido Tú. 

Señor, ha sido mi soporte,
En el momento que lo he necesitado, 
Caminé por el valle de sombra,
Y Tú cobertura siempre a mi lado. 

A veces miro mi pasado,
Pero mis errores Tú has perdonado,
Me has demostrado que yo soy tu hijo,
Me has protegido y amado. 

Me guías siempre en mi caminar,
En el desierto me has dado vida,
Agarrado de tu mano deseo andar, 
Pues como tú a mí nadie me cuida. 

Le diste sentido a mis días,
La roca cerca del camino,
Contigo llegó seguro al destino,
Si cuando despierto ante ti me inclino. 

Mi castillo y mi refugio siempre has sido Tú,
Mi lugar seguro cuando temo solo Tú,
Lo único que me llena eres Tú. 

No hay nadie que de ti me separe,
Mis preocupaciones yo te entregaré,
Aún en la tormenta yo te adoraré.
Por eso a ti clamaré, 
Pues de mi vida te he entregado el centro,
De no buscarte antes me lamento,
Hoy vas conmigo, pues te llevo dentro de mi corazón. 

A ti clamaré, 
Pues si la noche se hace fría y larga, 
Yo voy a ti y te entrego mis cargas,
Aunque el sol salga por donde salga, 
Sé que has sido Tú.

Porque yo sé los planes que tengo para ustedes, dice el Señor. 
Son planes para lo bueno y no para lo malo. 
Para darles un futuro y una esperanza.

snippet.description:
Use my link to grab an exclusive discount for your Displates : https://displate.com/l/backlogs 
And don't forget to use my code BACKLOGS to get 22% off 1 poster, 27% off 2 posters, or 33% off 3+ posters.

Stealthing through Dark Souls 2 is not a thing that should exist.
And yet here we are.
Walking past enemies, using distractions to draw their attention, and one-shotting anyone that dares stand in our way. 

I don't know why, but you can stealth through Dark Souls 2. And I'm going to show you how.

snippet.title: The MANY Removed Items of Mario Maker 2
snippet.description:
Super Mario Maker 2 is filled to the brim with a ton of different items and features to help creators make their stages. However, Nintendo wasn’t able to add EVERY item they wanted into the game. In the files there is evidence of MANY features and items that were developed for the game but were ultimately removed before the official release. These can be enemies, sound effects, platforms, and even power-ups! So today I thought it would be fun to talk about what some of these deleted items were and if I want to see them return for Super Mario Maker 3!

Plants Vs Zombies Fusion is a Chinese fan made game that takes the original PvZ, and gives you the ability to fuse plants together. Many think that it's one of the hardest mods in PvZ history, but this is actually untrue. As PvZ Fusion is actually a fan game, not a mod. The difference being that PvZ Fusion is built from the ground up in its own engine, and is not just a modification of the original game. Though I did play this on Max Difficulty, so it was soul crushingly hard. Some may even call it one of the weirdest PvZ games, but I believe it to be a MASTERPIECE.

Plants Vs Zombies Fusion is a Chinese fan made game that takes the original PvZ, and gives you the ability to fuse plants together. Many think that it's one of the hardest mods in PvZ history, but this is actually untrue. As PvZ Fusion is actually a fan game, not a mod. The difference being that PvZ Fusion is built from the ground up in its own engine, and is not just a modification of the original game. Though I did play this on Max Difficulty, so it was soul crushingly hard. Some may even call it one of the weirdest PvZ games, but I believe it to be a MASTERPIECE.

snippet.title: CALL OF DUTY: MODERN WARFARE 4 Full Gameplay Walkthrough / No Commentary【FULL GAME】4K Ultra HD
snippet.description:
CALL OF DUTY: MODERN WARFARE 4 Full Gameplay Walkthrough / No Commentary【FULL GAME】4K Ultra HD includes the full story, ending and final boss of the game. The game was played, recorded and edited by Gamer’s Little Playground team. We recorded the game in 4K 60FPS on the Playstation 5 Pro. The video also includes all cutscenes, final boss, all bosses, no commentary, all missions and all cinematics.

🌟 DESCRIPTION🌟

00:00 Modern Warfare Story Recap
02:19 Mission 1 - Mayhem (South Korea)
19:24 Mission 2 - Out in the Cold (New York City)
40:43 Mission 3 - Following Orders (North Korea)

02:32:08 Mission 9 - Survivors (North Korea)
02:43:03 Mission 10 - Stranded (North Korea)
03:34:09 Mission 11 - Defection (North Korea)
03:54:34 Mission 12 - Counter Attack (South Korea)
04:22:52 Mission 13 - Escape (North Korea)
04:38:52 Mission 14 - Entrenched (South Korea)
05:02:35  Mission 15 -- Decapitation (North Korea)
05:20:39 Mission 16 - Greater Good


Modern Warfare 4's story is centered on two protagonists: Private Park Hyun-Jun a South Korean Marine recruit who fights alongside his squad "Sierra-1" to protect his home, as an invasion of the Korean Peninsula by the Korean People's Army (KPA) threatens to destabilize the world; and Captain John Price the former leader of Task Force 141 who is on the run following his assassination of United States General Herschel Shepherd. As Park and Price each deal with their own conflict, another threat looms as a powerful weapon is being delivered to a mysterious individual known only as "the Archer".

snippet.title: My World is Writing a Book About Me
snippet.description:
A lone Minecraft player blogging his world named Charlie encounters a mysterious bookshelf that writes to him every day.







All content displayed here is fictional.
Story and video were written, created, edited, and produced by Namentix.
All builds seen in the video are by Namentix. 

Another 2 month long wait….really sorry everybody. But I hope the pay off was worth it this time around. Life got super busy but I'd like to thank all the new people I've met, you really returned my spark to me and reminded me why I do any of this at all.

A couple things: Yes, this is an adaptation of Robert W. Chambers' King in Yellow short stories. Yes, an AMAZING Minecraft ARG already exists about this character, however, 1. I love the Wifies adaptation, so no treading on that already. It’s a totally unique and different take 2. This is a public domain character 3. I wanted to take a shot at Hastur/KIY since I am also building a Cthulhu Mythos. This version is supposed to be much closer to Chambers’ version than Lovecraft’s, and (IMO) feels much different from the Wifies video. As always, though, I’d be open to hear what you would’ve wanted to see that could’ve differentiated it deeper for you.

Charlie is me in many ways. Insecure, lonely, frightened, and more likely to accept something fake over something real. This story helped me cope with my own stubbornness a lot, and the reason it took so incredibly long to produce was making sure I perfected this character. Auth definitely came secondary, but I think their stories mirror each other in such a way that they are both aspects of me. 

These builds were a lot of fun to produce, that double sun and crazy moon texture drove me crazy, maybe in some way I am also Lost, Dim, Lost in Carcosa now.

This is a much more slow burn, narrative and character driven story than my other videos. I hope it still hits just as hard and you love it just as much! This video all around is a gamble; it shares the same inspo from an extremely popular ARG, its very long, and its very dialogue/character heavy. I am crossing my fingers that it goes well, but I have a feeling it will :)

Almost forgot- that gate and sigil look familiar don't they? Where have we seen those before in my videos? :thinker:

Anyway, I loved making this. Even through all the blood, sweat, and tears it took. Thank you so much for your love and support. As always,

Namentix


Inspired by: Robert W. Chambers’ King in Yellow, TV Girl (for Moonlit Night (IYKYK)), Wifies, Lomedy, Zachobuilds, RetroGamingNow
Join the server! https://discord.gg/EunCjJFny4
Emoticons/Reactions were created by: MantaFizz. Please check them out! linktr.ee/mantafizz. 
Apple_Pie
They are extremely talented artists (as you can see)

Voice Cast (in order of appearance): 
Kerth Judd as Charlie Scriptor
NeonAstrum as Kwame
Biirdbrains as Sam
Reapthenight (ZYORAK!!!) as Elysande Berenger 
Nephrite as Zane

snippet.title: I've Never Said This In Public, But…
snippet.description:
Blizzard promised no sacrifices to quality. Then 12.1.5 shipped with a broken Labyrinth and bugs players had already reported on the PTR. From another round of emergency hotfixes to the deeper problems with gearing, balance and the eight-week patch cycle, it's time to ask why WoW's leadership keeps making promises the game doesn't deliver on.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
